about.label: About Jodhpur Church
about.title: A place to belong, believe & grow
about.description: Jodhpur Church is a community where people come together in faith, hope and love.
about.whoWeAreDescription: We are a Christian community committed to worshipping God, following Jesus Christ and growing together in faith.
about.welcomeDescription: Everyone is welcome to join us as we learn, pray, worship and serve together.
about.belongDescription: Our church is a place where people can find fellowship, encouragement and opportunities to grow in their relationship with God and with one another.
about.valuesDescription: We seek to live out our faith through worship, God's Word, love and service.
about.missionDescription: To worship God, follow Jesus Christ and share His love with others through our words and actions.
about.visionDescription: To grow as a faithful Christian community where people discover God's love and are encouraged to live their faith.
about.communityDescription: We believe church is more than a building. We are a community that supports, prays for and serves one another.

history.label: Our History
history.title: A journey of faith, prayer & service.
history.description: Jodhpur Church, Chhattisgarh, is a Catholic Christian community rooted in faith, worship, prayer, fellowship and service.
history.introductionDescription: Jodhpur Church is a Catholic Christian community where people come together to worship God, pray, listen to His Word and grow together in faith.
history.introductionDescriptionTwo: Our community carries forward a history of faith and pastoral service that goes back to the establishment of the Jodhpur mission in 1947.
history.introductionDescriptionThree: Through generations, the church has remained a place of prayer, worship, fellowship and service to the local community.
history.beginningDescription: The beginning of the Catholic mission established the foundation for the Christian community that would continue to grow in Jodhpur.
history.timelineDescription: The history of Jodhpur Church is closely connected with the Catholic mission in the region and the faith of the local Christian community.
history.timeline1947Description: The Catholic mission at Jodhpur began in 1947. Missionaries came from Kanjia in Bihar and began providing pastoral care and spiritual guidance to the Catholic community in the area.
history.milestone1947Description: The beginning of the Catholic mission established the foundation for the Christian community that would continue to grow in Jodhpur.
history.timeline1977Description: On 14 December 1977, the Diocese of Ambikapur was formally erected. Jodhpur became part of the wider pastoral structure of the new diocese.
history.timeline1977DescriptionTwo: This marked an important development in the organization and pastoral care of Catholic communities in the region.
history.timeline1981Description: The present church building at Jodhpur was built with the support of the Missio Swiss London Fund and the Holy Cross Institute.
history.timeline1981DescriptionTwo: The people of Jodhpur Parish also played an important part in supporting and contributing to the building of the church.
history.timelineInaugurationDescription: According to the parish historical record, the church was blessed and inaugurated on 22 December 1981 by the respected Bishop Philip Ekka.
history.historicDayDescription: The blessing and inauguration of the church marked an important milestone in the history of the Jodhpur Catholic community.
history.todayDescription: More than a place of worship, Jodhpur Church continues to be a gathering place for prayer, fellowship, spiritual growth and service.
history.todayDescriptionTwo: The story of the church continues through the families, children, young people and parishioners who gather together and carry forward the faith of previous generations.
history.legacyDescription: The history of Jodhpur Church is not only the history of a building. It is the story of missionaries, priests, families and parishioners who helped establish and strengthen the Christian community over generations.
history.faithDescription: A community founded on faith in Jesus Christ and strengthened through prayer and worship.
history.communityDescription: Generations of parishioners have contributed their time, faith and support to the life of the church.
history.serviceDescription: The church seeks to express Christian faith through compassion, fellowship and service to others.
history.faithSectionDescription: Our faith is centered on Jesus Christ and His message of love, forgiveness, hope and salvation.
history.faithSectionDescriptionTwo: We seek to live our faith not only through worship, but also through the way we care for one another and serve our community.
history.scripture: For where two or three are gathered in my name, there am I among them.
history.communitySectionDescription: We welcome families, children, young people and everyone who wishes to join us in prayer, worship and fellowship.
history.communitySectionDescriptionTwo: Whether you are visiting for the first time or have been part of our community for many years, we hope you find a place where you can grow in faith and experience the love of Christ.
history.communityCardDescription: Together in Christ, we continue the journey of faith that began generations ago.
history.ctaTitle: We would love to welcome you.
history.ctaDescription: Come and join us for worship, prayer and fellowship at Jodhpur Church.
